reviewEvidence.result: The exact 2.3.8 npm archive contains 27 files and no LICENSE, COPYING or NOTICE; no file carries an MIT grant or copyright line. The npm packument records gitHead b3b1287aad81def2e2ae707274b74531b61ddbaf, but that commit is unreachable: raw.githubusercontent.com and codeload.github.com return 404, the repository's upload-pack reports "not our ref", and no current ref contains package version 2.3.8. The repository's first LICENSE (MIT, Copyright (c) 2025 Anton Korzunov) was added in commit 7301c160fda44cb8cf2b9fdfde61efad35736196 on 2025-05-21, after 2.3.8 was published on 2024-12-15 and while the tree was still version 2.3.7, so it cannot establish the version-specific notice. No exact-version complete license or copyright line exists upstream.
